title: Touring with the World's Greatest Jazz Band and the Dutch connection
summary: Ted Easton heard her at the concert, which led to the Holland album; she tours with the band.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: I was just reading the other day when you lent me your Dutch album, that Ted Easton was in the audience that night.
I supposed that performance must've led to you recording in Holland two years later.
Yeah. Well, I was on tour with The World's Greatest Jazz Band in that year. And we played Amsterdam, and Ted Easton showed up and asked me to this album for him.

And, of course, I had to stay over to do the album. And that morning I looked and the bus was pulling off. The band was going to the next gig. And it was kind of a lonely feeling, you know, being in Amsterdam, Holland by yourself. And I didn't know that much about Ted Easton. And on top of that, he was late showing. Then I really got jittery.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Yeah. Well okay, I'll come back to that album in just a little while.
